title: Talent magnets vs. talent deserts: HR leaders share their top 2026 strategies
body_markdown:
Ralliant Voices


December 18, 2025


# Talent magnets vs. talent deserts: HR leaders share their top 2026 strategies


Chief People Officer Karen Bick shares how AI, continuous listening, and a deliberate approach to culture and growth are reshaping talent attraction and retention in 2026.


[Read More](https://hrexecutive.com/talent-magnets-vs-talent-deserts-hr-leaders-share-their-top-2026-strategies/)


CHIEF PEOPLE OFFICER


Karen Bick


Karen leads Ralliant’s people strategy, drawing on more than 25 years of experience building high-performance cultures in complex global organizations. Her approach combines systematic thinking, strategic insight, and a commitment to developing talent to create an environment where teams excel and innovation thrives.
